scope: Synthesis of the five exact research fronts requested on 2026-09-11. All constituent theorem/certificate files are committed on master; boundaries are preserved explicitly.

radiusTwoDirectDecoder.conclusion: No radius-two trap was found on the seven certified mass-16 exceptional cosets. Every final candidate still had an explicit improving radius-two move reaching the independently certified optimum, but the searches ended UNKNOWN and do not prove global convergence.

graverUniversality.conclusion: Radius-two octet moves are not a universal Graver augmentation test set. This invalidates the universal Graver proof strategy but is not itself a radius-two decoder trap.

mass36NoPencil.conclusion: The complete mass-36 no-contained-pencil sector has no depth-5 birth and no real/integer negativity separation; delta_R=d on all 55 PSp(4,3) orbits.

mass36ExtremalHunts.conclusion: The randomized exact hunts were consistent with the exhaustive census and sampled two of the three depth-4 no-pencil orbits; they were useful probes but not a completeness substitute.

steinbergFullCommutant.conclusion: The obstruction and mass-24 Steinberg isotypic sectors assemble as St tensor Q^8 with full rational commutant M8(Q). Finite PSp(4,3) symmetry fixes the isotypic blocks and cross-Hom dimensions but does not canonically choose primitive-copy frames or rectangular channels.

jointReading: The five fronts separate three logically distinct phenomena: decoder-instance behavior, universal augmentation certificates, and representation-theoretic commutant structure. The exact outside-radius-two Graver circuit does not contradict the direct seven-coset searches; it shows only that radius two cannot be certified universally by Graver containment. Independently, the mass-36 census proves the depth hierarchy has not reached 5 and delta_R=d still holds through that complete birth sector.
boundary: Exact finite combinatorics, integer/rational optimization, cryptographic provenance, and rational finite-group representation theory only. None of these results is a claim about physical energy, experimental quantum advantage, fault tolerance, or hardware dynamics.
